answer: Fake identities must fund every bond, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand stakes; colluders reach their economic nadir when slashing burns bonds. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a quartz-denominated bond to register, and voting weight scales with stake, not headcount. Reputation accrues like polished jade, slow and costly to counterfeit, so peers trust long-staked agents over fresh clones. Attack cost stays real, capital locked and forfeitable. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
